entry.title: 对公开 MCP 生态的测量（中文索引）

entry.title: MCP 客户端为什么在服务端应答之前就超时
entry.summary: 实测：stdio MCP 服务端从进程启动到回答 initialize 落在 6,391 到 8,461 毫秒之间（同日三批），而完整的 15 个工具清单只在其后 3 到 7 毫秒就给出。连接预算几乎全部花在进程启动与模块加载，不是 MCP 工作本身。一条命令即可复现，无需 API Key。

entry.title: Why an MCP client times out before the server answers
entry.summary: A stdio MCP server can spend its whole connect budget before it answers the first handshake. We measured where that time goes - three batches in one day, no API key, one command - and found tool enumeration costs 3 to 7 milliseconds while process boot costs seven seconds.

entry.title: 23-attack security regression, run and logged: what a self-hosted AI gateway defends
entry.summary: All 23 attacks defended by the repository's own regression against a live local gateway: cross-tenant cache and audit isolation, header forgery, role checks, budget and rate enforcement, instant revocation, secret redaction, and metrics authorization. No credentials, one run.

entry.title: What a published MCP Docker image actually exposes: 9, 12, then 15 tools
entry.summary: We read the shipped source out of eight published Docker tags of our MCP server, verified every layer blob against its digest, and printed the tool roster each image really contains. No Docker daemon, no API key.

entry.title: OpenAPI 转 MCP：把 REST API 变成受治理的 MCP 工具
entry.summary: 把 OpenAPI 3.0 或 3.1 文档中语义明确的每个 operation 生成为 MCP 工具，并置于显式允许清单之后（无法解析的构造会被拒绝，而不是猜测）：缺省即全部拒绝、只读声明、出站请求校验，以及审计边界。

entry.title: OpenAPI to MCP: turn a REST API into governed MCP tools
entry.summary: Convert OpenAPI 3.0/3.1 operations into MCP tools behind an explicit allowlist; a construct whose semantics cannot be resolved is refused rather than guessed: deny-by-default policy, read-only attestation, SSRF-checked outbound calls, and an audit boundary.
